decision.why: The enlarged baseline recovers substantial melody but only 8 of 38 pilot chords. The format audit identifies unpromoted text as a plausible integration failure. Holding melody fixed isolates whether chord OCR and structured conversion recover useful information within the four-experiment budget; timing and musician review remain unresolved.
decision.hypothesis: Some missing chords are legible image text that can be recovered through a separate constrained recognition stage without changing melody transcription.
decision.expected_observation: More than eight correctly matched pilot chords and lower chord edit error, with unchanged melody error; failure to improve would argue that text recognition or symbol interpretation, rather than harmony export alone, is the bottleneck.

config.approach: Keep enlarged Audiveris melody recognition fixed and add a conservative image-derived chord-text recognition and structured harmony conversion stage.
config.objective: On the seven first-per-song pilot excerpts, recover missing printed chord symbols from the region above the staff using enlarged-image OCR and a strict chord grammar. Convert roots, qualities, explicit extensions and slash basses into a parseable editable kern harmony spine. Preserve existing melody events; record chord bounding boxes and proposed onset alignment separately, marking ambiguous timing for review. Do not infer absent symbols from musical plausibility or consult references.
config.success_criteria: Produce sealed parseable predictions for all seven pilot images, source code and per-image diagnostics distinguishing OCR failures, unsupported chord syntax and uncertain onset alignment. Compare protected chord edit error and matches with enlarged Audiveris baseline (30/38 errors, 8 matches), and verify melody error does not increase from 87/130 errors. Include round-trip parse checks and synthetic transposition checks for melody, chord roots and slash basses; distinguish these checks from measured transcription correctness. Report timing as unaudited.

last_observation.summary: Implemented and ran conservative enlarged-image chord OCR with strict harmony conversion. Seven outputs contain 15 accepted OCR chord candidates; these are not verified matches. All seven enlarged Audiveris melody baselines were unavailable, so melody preservation and non-regression could not be verified; incomplete outputs count as failures. Synthetic chord round-trip, root/slash-bass transposition, kern parsing and melody transposition checks passed. Protected transcription metrics were unavailable, so improvement over baseline is unmeasured. Timing remains unaudited. Goal unmet.

observation.note: Frozen worker output; only protected evaluation measures accuracy.
